# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Pris  <sub>[v3 c4 P9](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0009), [v3 c9 P19](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a tall girl, standing a good two inches taller than most of her peers. She has a pale, spiritual-looking countenance.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, with a mind full of mischief, pranks, and fun. She possesses a lively sense of humor and an unselfish admiration for her friends. Though practical at times, she enjoys nature, poetry, and harmless fun.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c13 P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067), [v3 c4 P7](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0007)_

## Goals

- Attain a college education at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley and later taught at the Carmody school for two years. After deciding to further her education, she accepted the Carmody school position for another term before entering Redmond College. In her Freshman year at Redmond, she boarded at the same house as Anne Shirley and became a close friend and companion. Along with Anne, Philippa Gordon, and Stella Maynard, she helped set up house at Patty's Place under the chaperonage of Aunt Jamesina. Priscilla pursued a course in Classics, ultimately graduating from Redmond College with Honors in Classics.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P17](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0017), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c16 P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P30](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0030)_
